ev.q: PrEP awareness and referrals among Hispanic persons were compared with those of persons of other racial and ethnic groups.
HIV Preexposure Prophylaxis Awareness and Referral to Providers Among Hispanic/Latino Persons
PrEP referral was lower among Black Hispanic persons (13.4%; PR = 0.55) and Hispanic persons of other races (21.6%; PR = 0.89)
awareness was higher among persons aged 25–49 years (29.9%; PR = 1.07) and lower among those aged ≥50 years (17.0%; PR = 0.60)
awareness was highest among transgender persons (68.6%; PR = 4.74) followed by males (36.6%; PR = 2.53)
PrEP awareness was higher among gay, bisexual, and other men who have sex with men (MSM) (63.5%; PR = 3.62)
